rows.ARS:
Orange or orange-red Floribunda.
Registration name: SANmar
Exhibition name: Bright Eyes
rows.Origin:
Bred by John W. Sanday (United Kingdom, before 1983).
Introduced in United Kingdom by John Sanday (Roses) Ltd. in 1983 as 'Bright Eyes'.
rows.Bloom: Vermilion, yellow stamens. Mild fragrance. up to 10 petals. Medium, semi-double (9-16 petals), cluster-flowered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Bushy. Medium, matte, dark green foliage.

Height: up to 39" (up to 100cm).
